about: Which cases a source change can reach. The most specific path wins (longest match). A changed file that matches no area is 'impact unknown', never 'no impact'. An area reaches a case through the case's provider: eligibility counts, not which rule won last time.

areas.why: Documents, the growth checker, tests and CI. Nothing here is in the program a game loads.
The shared camera rules. Both Route B providers can select them, whichever rule won in a game's last run.
Shared input discovery for Route B.
The native DX11 provider, its consumer, the disabled DX11 bridge and the layouts the DX11 provider starts from. Any DX11 game reaches them.
DX12 scene observation and live DLAA. The native DX11 consumer includes parts of j2, so a change here can reach DX11 games too.
The native-DLSS route: the Streamline boundary and the engine adapters.
Everything else in the program is treated as shared by both routes and both APIs: the DLSS backend, the menu and overlay, settings, hooks, start-up, effects, motion, the runtime proxy.
What is built and what the installer puts in each game's folder.
